text: Hello sorry to trouble you so late at nite. I have my grandaughter staying with me shes 10 years old and her temprature has gone up to 40 which has given me a fright as she doesnt usually run hot like that. She has a few itchy bites on her arms and legs from being out in the garden, midges or something, she keeps scratching them. Theres also a bit of a rash on her chest so I remembered about doing the glass test and I pressed a glass on it and it goes pale and fades away so I hope thats alright. Her colour is fine, her skin and lips look normal to me, not pale or anything. I dont want to be a nuisence and Im probably fussing over nothing but her mum and dad are abroad and I just wanted to check whether I should be doing anything else or if I just keep an eye on her through the night. Thankyou so much
